description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] State the principal you claim and the purpose you claim, in your own words. This is a purpose claim by an enrolled actor. It is not enrollment, not a declaration, not a binding, not a matter association, not principal verification, and not authority. It grants nothing and does not admit you. Do not send a matter id or an objective id.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

principal.description: Who you are acting for, in your own words. Atlas records it as UNVERIFIED and does not grant authority for it.

purpose.description: Why you want this, in your own words.

name: atlas.claim_purpose
title: Claim purpose
